answer: Bind each identity to one state-licensed master electrician certificate on the register. Earning it takes a 4-year apprenticeship, 8,000 hours wiring homes by the river, an exam and a 400-unit fee; one certificate backs exactly one identity. Each fake costs one electrician, 400 units and 1,460 days, so 100 fakes cost 40,000 units and 400 apprentice-years, a thread no shortcut compresses. Cheapest cheat: hire an electrician to lend it, but the lender loses their own identity, a forgery fails the register check, and a random inspection, like a raven, exposes the borrower and revokes both.
